headline: Acquisition-led growth; organic growth is weak

drivers.explanation: Growth came largely from acquisitions (about $156M of acquisition revenue in the quarter), with organic growth of only 1.2%.
CEO cites a challenging rate environment, offset by wins from broader capabilities after the Accession acquisition.

summary_short: Brown & Brown reported Q3 revenue of $1.7B (+7.4% y/y) with organic growth of just 1.2%, and adjusted EPS of $1.07 (+1.9%).
summary_long: Net income rose 5.7% to $240M but diluted EPS slipped 1.5% to $0.67. Adjusted EBITDAC rose 1.7% to $597M and its margin narrowed to 34.6% from 36.6%. Pre-tax income was $320M, up 2.9%. Nine-month revenue rose 23.4% to $5.3B on the Accession deal. The release gives no numeric guidance.
confidence_notes: Adjusted EPS and EBITDAC are company-defined non-GAAP measures.
